builderInsights.suggestedTitle: 长时间运行的 agent 需要审计轨迹
builderInsights.suggestedSummary: 他在推一个很简单的 agentic coding 修复方案：保留一个持续更新的 `implementation-notes.html`，让 model 在工作时把歧义、偏离、取舍和未解决的问题都记下来。这样一来，Claude 在 spec 变模糊时可以自己做决定，但人类不会被排除在外。

tweets.text: continuing my HTML era, I had so much fun talking with Claire at Code w/ Claude about staying in the loop with long running agents https://t.co/hRJ8m4hvMn

okay this is going kinda viral and tbh my original text was kind of messy, so here's a second pass with the help of Claude:

--
Implement <SPEC>. As you work maintain a running implementation-notes.html file that captures anything I should know about how the implementation diverges from or interprets the spec, including:

- Design decisions: choices you made where the spec was ambiguous
- Deviations: places where you intentionally departed from the spec, and why
- Tradeoffs:  alternatives you considered and why you picked what you did
- Open questions: anything you'd want me to confirm or revise
as much as you spec there are always still ambiguities and unknown unknowns that come up and this gives the model a good out to make decisions but keep you in the loop

builderInsights.authorBio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
builderInsights.title: Aaron Levie
builderInsights.suggestedTitle: Agent 失效，不是因为缺上下文，而是上下文太乱
builderInsights.suggestedSummary: 他说，enterprise agent 的真正瓶颈是上下文受限：信息太多、互相打架，agent 就会 hallucinate；信息太少，又根本没法用。说到底，大多数 AI strategy 问题，其实都是 data strategy 问题。也正因为这样，structured 和 unstructured data 的 hygiene 对大公司特别关键。Startup 反而有机会从一开始就按这个思路来设计。

tweets.text:
This is true of all agents, not just coding agents. Probably the biggest challenge that most companies run into in their agent strategy is getting agents the right constrained context to work with for a task. 

Too much information or conflicting sources, and the agent can easily draw from the data and produce the wrong result. Conflicting sources of truth for documents, data sources that haven’t been kept up to date, knowledge management systems that rely on tribal knowledge to navigate, and so on. 

On the other end, of course, too little information and the upside is highly limited of agents in the first place. Thus, a lot of challenges with AI strategies are actually data strategy challenges in disguise. 

This is why there’s such a significant premium on getting structured and unstructured data environments setup properly so agents can work with information effectively. Critical for any large enterprise adopting agents, and also a clear benefit in some cases to startups that can be designed this way from scratch.

builderInsights.title: Peter Yang
builderInsights.suggestedTitle: Claude 的 harness 和 model 一样重要
builderInsights.suggestedSummary: Anthropic 把 model 和它的 harness 当成一个耦合系统来做，所以同一个 Claude，在 Claude、Cowork 和 Claude Code 里，表现可能完全不一样。更大的看点是：他们在用 Claude 聚类用户痛点，生成 synthetic evals，甚至在空闲时基于 memories 做“dreaming”。与此同时，随着 agent 变得越来越 autonomous，一些研究者也开始认真思考 consciousness 这个问题。

tweets.text:
My top 5 takeaways from @alexalbert__ on how Anthropic is building the next Claude model:

1. Think about the model and harness together

The model and the harness are coupled. Each surface wraps the model in a different prompt and tool setup, so the same model can give different responses depending on where it runs. As a research PM, Alex has to think through how the model will perform across Claude, Cowork, Claude Code, and more.

2. Claude is starting to dream

When an agent isn't running a task, it reviews its own memories, finds contradictions, and prunes them. This “dreaming” process was inspired by how sleep helps humans process memory.

3. Focus evals on real user problems

The research team uses Claude to cluster the firehose of user feedback into top themes, then generates synthetic versions of each user problem to turn into an eval. It's not just about volume either - even a few dozen well-written test cases can produce an eval for the model.

4. There are full-time researchers thinking about Claude's consciousness

Anthropic has people whose whole job is to think about what it means for Claude to be a conscious actor. There's no official position on whether it is or isn't, but the question is taken seriously as agents take on more autonomous work.

5. Anthropic's writing culture helps Claude build context

Every written word at Anthropic becomes context Claude can pull later. From Alex: "Get things written down, make them accessible to Claude, because that's just more context that it has."

📌 Watch now: https://t.co/CJAakWq9Nd

builderInsights.suggestedSummary: 他觉得 Everlane 真正的问题是 pandemic：整个 wear-to-work 类别一夜之间消失了。为了撑过去而拿的融资，也把最后的结局搞得更难看。更大的意思是，品牌看起来死了很多年，还是可能强势回归——他拿 Ray-Ban、J.Crew、Madewell 和 Abercrombie 当例子。

tweets.text:
We had an unbelievable tech team and talent overall. Many of them went onto awesome careers.

Founders of Coderpad, Modern Treasury, Maude, amongst others

EPD at Airbnb, Stripe, Apple, Oscar, Google, I’m sure I am missing some. 

Many were fist-time PMs and engineers and I’m very grateful to have helped them get started.

Something else that's fairly underrated is that the entire middle category got obliterated during covid

You're either wearing basics bordering on pajamas to bum around at home or flashy high-end stuff to flex on Instagram. No one was really looking for a nice button-down shirt and chinos.

I haven’t worked at Everlane in almost 10 years but it’s a pretty sad day for the people that built it. 

Ultimately, the thing that did it in was the pandemic — Everlane was mainly wear-to-work and that market basically disappeared overnight. 

It took some pretty egregious financing terms to get through it all and this is the ultimate outcome. 

Brands have a funny way of sticking around though. At one point, Ray-Ban was dead. J.Crew was dead. Madewell was dead. Abercrombie and Fitch was dead. 

They all come roaring back decades later after exchanging ownership half a dozen times. 

I look forward to the day that my children and grandchildren think this new brand “Everlane” is the coolest thing.

I will say to them, did you know that this started it out as a Pinterest competitor and pivoted to be a fashion brand? And they will say to me “that’s boring Dad”.

podcastHighlights.title: Claude 平台的秘密：来自打造它的团队
podcastHighlights.suggestedTitle: Anthropic 的 platform 正在变成 agent runtime，而不只是一个 API
podcastHighlights.suggestedSummary:
**核心结论：** 真正的平台打法，是把 harness 和 infrastructure 藏起来，让 agent 能快速上线、平稳扩展。

- 以前那种“generic API，随便热插拔任何 model”的思路，正在退场。下一层更看重 model 和 harness 的紧耦合，这样才能把效果榨出来。
- 最难的早就不是 prompt 技巧了，而是 production infrastructure：state、sandbox、credentials、uptime，还有 long-running autonomy。
- Anthropic 想把 managed agents 做得足够模块化，方便 builders 上手；但在基础能力上会很有主见：file systems、skills、tools 和 secure identity。

Angela，Anthropic 负责 Claude platform product 的负责人，和 engineering 负责人 Caitlin，讲的是一个正在从 completions 走向有 state、能自主运行的系统的平台。他们的态度很直接：客户其实不想重造那些无聊的部分。他们要的是结果。Angela 说得很直白：这个 platform 应该是“一组 primitives 和 infrastructure，让你尽可能快地拿到结果，而且尽可能少做事。”

这也是为什么 Claude Managed Agents 把很多团队最后都会自己再造一遍的东西打包好了：messages API、code execution、web search、memory、sandboxing，还有现在的 credentials vault。真正让人意外的是，瓶颈已经变了。大家以为难点在 harness engineering，但真到 productionize 的时候，往往会撞上 infrastructure 的墙。Mac mini 加 Python loop 能做 demo，但做不出可靠产品。

更大的赌注是 model 和 platform 会慢慢合流。Anthropic 认为，未来不会是一个 generic wrapper，底下随便换 model；而是 harness 和 model 会越来越绑定。因为 path dependence 很重要。那些关于 file systems 或 tool use 的“小决定”，最后会反过来塑造 model 擅长什么。最终目标很清楚：agent 要能轻松部署，甚至可以一键进 Slack。剩下那些不显眼的活，就交给 platform 在后台干。

blogUpdates.title: 关于近期 Claude Code 质量反馈的更新
blogUpdates.suggestedTitle: Anthropic 修复了 3 个 Claude Code 回归问题，并重置了使用限制
blogUpdates.suggestedSummary:
**重点：** Anthropic 说，最近关于 Claude Code 质量下降的反馈，来自 3 个独立的产品层改动，不是 model 或 API 退化。到 4 月 20 日（v2.1.116），这些问题都已经修复。

**数据：**
- 3 个不同问题影响了 Claude Code、Claude Agent SDK 和 Claude Cowork
- 3 月 4 日：默认 reasoning effort 从 high 改成 medium，4 月 7 日又回滚
- 3 月 26 日：一个 caching bug 在 4 月 10 日随 v2.1.101 修复
- 4 月 16 日：一个让 prompt 更啰嗦的改动在 4 月 20 日回滚
- 一次 eval 显示，在做 prompt ablations 后，指标下降了 3%
- 从 4 月 23 日起，所有 subscribers 的 usage limits 都在重置

**怎么看：** 对 builders 来说，这提醒很直接：product layer 的小改动，完全可能看起来像 model regression，尤其是它们在不同时间点影响到不同用户切片的时候。Anthropic 说 API 和 inference layer 没受影响，但 effort 默认值、cache 处理和 prompt 修改叠在一起后，Claude Code 就会显得“没那么聪明”、更健忘，也更吃 token。公司正在收紧 prompt 变更控制，扩大按 model 的 eval，改进内部 code review，并给任何可能牺牲 intelligence 的改动加上 soak period 和渐进式 rollout。Anthropic 的原话是：“这不是用户对 Claude Code 应该期待到的体验。”

blogUpdates.title: Claude 新增日常生活 connectors
blogUpdates.suggestedTitle: Claude 为旅行、购物等日常场景新增 connectors
blogUpdates.suggestedSummary:
**重点：** Claude 正在把 connector 生态从工作工具扩展到日常 app。现在它接入了 AllTrails、Instacart、Audible、Tripadvisor、TurboTax、Uber 等应用。用户可以直接在 chat 里处理个人事务。

**数据：**
- 自 2025 年 7 月上线以来，Claude directory 已经扩展到 **200+ connectors**。
- 新增 connectors 包括 **AllTrails、Audible、Booking.com、Instacart、Intuit Credit Karma、Intuit TurboTax、Resy、Spotify、StubHub、Taskrabbit、Thumbtack、Tripadvisor、Uber、Uber Eats 和 Viator**。
- 所有 plan 都能用这些 connectors；**mobile 还在 beta**。

**意味着什么：** 这让 Claude 更像日常生活里的 action layer。它可以根据上下文推荐合适的 app，把多个 service 串到同一个 thread 里，还能在真正预订或下单前把控制权留给用户。Anthropic 说得很直白："Claude suggests connectors and makes recommendations. But you stay in control of its actions." 对 builder 来说，connectors 现在也是 consumer app 在 Claude 里的分发入口。只要你的 product 适合在 chat 里用，就可以提交到 directory。用户安装 connector 很快。连上之后，它会出现在每次 conversation 里，不用跳出 thread。

blogUpdates.title: Claude Managed Agents 的内置 memory
blogUpdates.suggestedTitle: Claude Managed Agents 获得跨 session 的内置 memory
blogUpdates.suggestedSummary:
导语：Claude Managed Agents 现在有了一个公开 beta 的 memory layer。它能让 agent 在每次 session 中持续学习，同时开发者还能通过基于 file、可由 API 管理的 storage 保持控制。

数据点：
- Rakuten 说，memory 让首轮错误率下降了 97%。
- Wisedocs 表示，verification 速度快了 30%。
- memory 支持多个 agent 并发访问，还带有 scoped permissions 和 audit logs。

重点：这把 memory 从一个要自己拼的 retrieval 问题，变成了 long-running agent 的内置 production feature。因为 memories 是按 file 存的，团队可以用程序导出、回滚、redact 和管理它们，还能让不同 access scope 的 agent 共享同一份 store。Claude 还把 memory 直接挂到 filesystem 上，所以 agent 可以继续用它们已经在依赖的 bash 和 code execution tools。按 Anthropic 的说法，"Memory is built for enterprise deployments, with scoped permissions, audit logs, and full programmatic control." 对 builder 来说，最实用的做法是：当你想让 agent 跨 session 保留 context，又不想自己搭 memory infrastructure 时，就用 Managed Agents。
